axiomtalentplatform-axiomtalentplatform:.description: Axiom is seeking skilled corporate lawyers with experience in mergers and acquisitions, real estate transactions, and corporate governance to support our clients on full-time interim engagements. Ideal candidates will have experience conducting due diligence, drafting deal documentation, and negotiating commercial contracts from both an in-house and private practice perspective, and will be available to work a hybrid in-office schedule in Sydney or Brisbane. Responsibilities: Provide legal support on M&A transactions, including due diligence, structuring, and drafting/negotiating key transaction documents. Draft, review, and negotiate real estate documentation, including leases, sale and purchase agreements, and related property contracts. Prepare, review, and negotiate a broad range of commercial agreements (e.g. services, supply, vendor, and confidentiality agreements). Provide timely, pragmatic legal advice to internal stakeholders on corporate, commercial, and regulatory matters, managing legal risk appropriately. Liaise with and manage external counsel and other advisors as required to support transactions and projects. Requirements: 5+ years’ post-qualification experience advising on complex M&A transactions, including legal due diligence, deal structuring, and drafting/negotiating SPAs, shareholder agreements, and ancillary documentation for corporate and institutional clients. Strong background in real estate transactions, with a track record of drafting, reviewing, and negotiating commercial leases, sale and purchase agreements, and related property contracts across a range of asset classes. Broad commercial contracts expertise, including preparing, reviewing, and negotiating services, supply, vendor, and confidentiality agreements, and providing pragmatic, business-focused advice on associated corporate and regulatory issues. Proven ability to partner with internal stakeholders and manage external counsel on cross-functional projects and transactions, balancing legal risk with commercial objectives within fast-paced in-house and/or private practice environments. Compensation, Benefits & Location: This role offers a highly competitive compensation and benefits package in the alternative legal services marketplace, that includes health benefits, pension and more. Axiomites also get access to professional development resources and learning and development programs. Axiomites predominately work remotely, with the exception that some clients require on-site presence. Axiom is the global leader in high-calibre, on-demand legal talent. Covering North America, the UK, Europe, and APAC, we enable legal departments to drive efficiency and growth and meet the demands of today’s business landscape with best in breed alterative legal services. Axiom is a leader in diversity, inclusion, and social engagement. Diversity is core to our values and we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We are proud to be named a best place to work for LGBTQ+ Equality, earning top marks in the 2021 Corporate Equality Index for the second consecutive year. Axiom’s legal department is Mansfield certified and is committed to considering at least 50% diverse candidates for leadership roles and outside counsel representation. Learn more about working at Axiom . cic-cic:lever:488d0ff2-0585-477c-bc4e-ef.description: Systems & Network Engineer Are you a Systems & Network Engineer with a passion for designing, implementing, and maintaining robust infrastructure solutions? If so, CIC invites you to join our dynamic team as a Systems & Network Engineer. As a key member of our technology department, you will play a pivotal role in ensuring the reliability, security, and efficiency of our systems and network architecture. ABOUT CIC CIC builds and operates spaces where startups, scale-ups, corporations, and public institutions come together to overcome challenges and grow. Founded in 1999, CIC was one of the first companies to offer flexible office space and coworking options, providing a platform for entrepreneurs to develop their ideas in a shared environment. CIC manages a global network of workspaces, laboratories, and event spaces across North America, Europe, and Asia. Beyond our spaces, CIC also develops innovation-focused programming, builds and enables industry clusters, and offers consulting services to help the public and private sectors foster innovation ecosystems. We invite you to explore our opportunities and learn more about our teams here. YOUR DAY-TO-DAY WORK As a Systems & Network Engineer at CIC, you will be responsible for ensuring the reliability, security, and scalability of our systems and network infrastructure. You will play a critical role in the design, implementation, and maintenance of our systems to support our current and future business requirements. Key Responsibilities: Networks: Monitor, troubleshoot, configure our networks (we are very heavy on Wi-Fi, which is one of the main services provided to our members) with hundreds of Access Points and low footprint network stacks (Extreme / Ruckus) Physical Access Control: Set up and manage scalable and reliable door access controls for CIC’s Campuses across the world. This means thousands of locks globally, even more user access cards which must give and take access to our spaces securely and reliably. Deploy and Maintain: Introduce and operate core and auxiliary systems, including but not limited to cloud services (Google Workspace / GCP / Atlassian JIRA SM / ElasticSearch) and internal tools running on docker / kubernetes and both Windows and Linux VMs Capacity Planning: Monitor network traffic and systems usage patterns, and proactively plan for capacity expansion to meet growing demands. Vendor Management: Collaborate with vendors and suppliers to procure and maintain network hardware, software, and services at quality level. Documentation: Maintain comprehensive network and systems documentation, including network diagrams, configurations, and change management records. Collaboration: Work closely with cross-functional teams to understand their requirements and provide technical guidance and support. Emergency Response: Participate in on-call rota for network-related emergencies and provide timely resolution and support. ABOUT YOU Highly skilled and experienced professional who possesses a combination of technical expertise, independency, and a commitment to ensuring the integrity and performance of systems and network infrastructure. Here are the key characteristics and qualifications of the ideal candidate: Demonstrates a deep understanding of network protocols, technologies, and best practices. You know what ANonce and SNonce are and network attenuation is no stranger to you. Exceptional problem-solving and troubleshooting skills, with the ability to diagnose complex IT issues and implement effective solutions. Proven ability to design and implement IT solutions to meet the organization's requirements, ensuring high availability and scalability. Possesses excellent communication skills, both written and verbal, for conveying complex technical information to non-technical stakeholders. Our partner is looking for a Romanian Voice Actor – Freelance AI Trainer Project based in Saudi Arabia. This freelance opportunity is designed for an experienced Romanian voice professional interested in helping shape the next generation of AI-powered speech technology. You will contribute authentic, high-quality Romanian voice data used to improve the clarity, naturalness, and expressiveness of AI-generated speech. The work combines professional voice performance with speech evaluation, linguistic feedback, and AI training activities. You will record scripted content while assessing AI outputs for pronunciation, tone, pacing, emotional expression, and regional accuracy. Your expertise will help refine voice models and evaluation standards for applications spanning accessibility, education, entertainment, and more. jobgether-jobgether:lever:8594106f-a5be-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Head of Data Center Design based in United Kingdom. As Head of Data Center Design, you will take ownership of the technical vision and architecture for a major next-generation AI data center development in Europe. You’ll lead design decisions across power, cooling, IT infrastructure, fire protection, networking, and structural considerations. The role offers significant technical influence, from early site feasibility and concept development through detailed engineering and construction execution. You’ll establish the Basis of Design and ensure that multidisciplinary teams remain aligned with performance, capacity, efficiency, and reliability objectives. Working with technology partners and implementation teams, you’ll ensure approved designs translate effectively into real-world infrastructure. The environment is international, technically complex, and focused on large-scale, high-density compute infrastructure. This is an opportunity to shape a critical infrastructure project designed to support the rapidly growing demands of AI and advanced computing. Own the overall technical design, architecture, and engineering vision for large-scale data center facilities. Define and maintain the Basis of Design , covering modular POD architecture, cooling strategy, power topology, fire suppression, networking, and other critical infrastructure requirements. Establish design standards for IT deployment, including rack layouts, containerization approaches, and CDU placement. Lead multidisciplinary design reviews and approve engineering drawings across electrical, mechanical, structural, fire protection, and networking disciplines. Establish and monitor design-stage targets for PUE, capacity, availability, redundancy, and reliability . Coordinate with equipment manufacturers, technology providers, and engineering partners on technical specifications and integration requirements. Work closely with implementation and construction teams to ensure that physical execution remains aligned with the approved design intent. Assess and approve proposed design changes, evaluating their potential impact on cooling, power, capacity, redundancy, performance, and reliability. Lead technical criteria for site selection and feasibility assessments, including power availability, grid connectivity, cooling options, and other infrastructure considerations. Provide technical leadership throughout the design lifecycle and ensure consistent engineering standards across projects and disciplines. Requirements 5+ years of experience in data center design or in the design of critical infrastructure, industrial, energy, or similarly complex facilities ; direct data center experience is highly valued but not mandatory. Demonstrated ownership of, or significant contribution to, Basis of Design documentation for large-scale facilities. At least 3 years of experience in a design leadership or technical leadership position. Strong technical knowledge of power distribution/topology and cooling strategies , with sufficient working knowledge of fire suppression and structural loading to coordinate effectively across disciplines. Proven experience leading multidisciplinary design reviews and reviewing or approving engineering drawings across multiple technical trades. Strong ability to translate technical requirements into clear design standards, decisions, and execution requirements. Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to collaborate with engineering teams, technology partners, suppliers, and construction teams. Professional English proficiency sufficient for international technical documentation, meetings, and stakeholder communication. Experience with modular or POD-based deployment architectures and high-density GPU/HPC environments is a strong advantage. Knowledge of direct liquid cooling (DLC) systems

jobgether-jobgether:lever:e3bb3f1a-e879-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Director of Finance & Business Performance based in United Kingdom. This is a senior finance leadership role focused on rebuilding and transforming the finance function of a growing multi-location food-service business. You will take ownership of core financial operations while strengthening cash management, payroll, reporting, controls, and compliance. Beyond traditional finance responsibilities, you will turn financial data into practical insights that guide business decisions and improve performance. You will lead budgeting, forecasting, profitability analysis, and investment evaluation across locations, brands, channels, and products. The role requires a commercially minded finance leader who can connect financial performance with pricing, operations, and growth decisions. You will also redesign finance structures, systems, and controls to create a more scalable and reliable function. This opportunity is ideal for an experienced finance executive who enjoys building from the ground up and creating lasting organizational impact. Lead the finance function through a hands-on transformation, establishing strong processes, controls, reporting standards, and operating rhythms. Take ownership of core financial operations, ensuring cash, payroll, compliance, and other critical financial responsibilities are properly controlled. Build accurate, timely, and actionable financial reporting that gives leadership clear visibility into business performance. Own annual budgets, rolling forecasts, cash planning, and financial projections, continuously updating assumptions based on business performance. Develop profitability reporting by location, brand, channel, and product to identify performance gaps and opportunities for improvement. Analyze unit economics and financial drivers to help leadership understand the factors influencing profitability and sustainable growth. Evaluate pricing, promotions, investments, and strategic initiatives through robust financial models and business cases. Partner with operational and commercial leaders to translate financial insights into practical actions and measurable business improvements. Redesign finance team structures, systems, workflows, and internal controls to improve efficiency, accuracy, scalability, and accountability. Introduce modern finance technologies, AI tools, and automation to streamline reporting, analysis, forecasting, and decision-making. Establish clear financial performance metrics and ensure leadership has timely visibility into risks, opportunities, and key business trends. Develop finance talent and build a sustainable succession plan, including the eventual development of a successor capable of taking ownership of the function. Provide evidence-based financial guidance to senior executives and constructively challenge decisions when financial analysis indicates a different course of action. Strong commercial understanding, including pricing strategy, unit economics, investment analysis, profitability drivers, and business-case development. Advanced, hands-on experience with AI, automation, modern finance technologies, and data-driven financial analysis. Strong accounting and financial management knowledge, with a professional finance or accounting qualification strongly preferred.
